content: {"phoneNote":"The phone first screen works: photo, headline and offer read in order, though the two text links at the bottom are weak as calls to action.","desktopNote":"Desktop pricing table hugs the left half and leaves the right half of the section empty, and the dark CTA band repeats contacts already in the footer.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Make 'Pišite nam' a real primary button and demote 'Poglejte cene'; the underlined text links are hard to notice as actions on both viewports.","On desktop let the price list span the full container or add a photo/course note in the empty right half; tighten the large top/bottom padding of every section.","Replace the generic sunset-village photo in 'Prvo srečanje' with a dancing couple or the hall, and drop the duplicated 'Pišite nam' link there so the dark 'Prijavite se' band is the only secondary CTA."],"blockers":["Phone hero and second photo: the 'Ustvarjeno' generated label is clipped at the right edge of the image, cutting the word."]}
